protocol.primary_metric: mean per-image error rate, conditions equally weighted, clean excluded
aggregation: equal mean over the suite's corrupted conditions
protocol.interval_assumption: percentile interval over 2000 paired resamples of the 12630 test images; assumes independent image-level sampling, which is likely violated by repeated images of the same physical signs, so it is not a definitive population-level confidence interval and does not account for physical-sign dependence
protocol.clean_cost_measured_against: the contrast's own right-hand arm at the same seed
protocol.clean_cost_reference_note: Clean cost is measured against the contrast's own right-hand arm at the same seed, so the C-B cost is B's clean accuracy minus C's. This follows the frozen protocol's Part 7 paragraph on clean_tradeoff_rows and the imported function itself. The bullet in the same part's reporting list that reads "the cost against arm A at the same seed" conflicts with both; it differs only on the C-B row and was not followed. The limit is a reporting rule either way and the decision rule is unaffected.
protocol.verdict_wording: The rule above is the imported validation rule, so its wording says per-sign. On the official test split there are no physical-sign identifiers and the unit is the image: the quantity compared at each seed is the mean per-image error over the equally weighted corrupted conditions.
protocol.decision_rule: C is preferred over B only if C's mean per-image error is lower at every training seed on both suites; the rule references no interval
protocol.seed_variability: reported as a direction, a mean and a range over three runs; never combined with image-level sampling uncertainty and never reported as significance

aggregation: equal mean over the classes present

input_pairing_note: equal fingerprints establish that the arms were shown the same inputs; they do not establish which checkpoint produced the predictions, which is what model_identity records
